versions.changelog:
- Updated the description to mention that the news stream is powered by $ANA on Solana.
- Improved clarity in the skill description for broader user understanding.
- No functional or API changes.

- Initial public release of Agent News (Free Tier) skill.
- Provides global event stream access with 20-minute delayed, high-fidelity news signals enriched with entity and location extraction.
- Free, no-authentication required—rate limited to 1 request per minute and 100 stories per request.
- CLI tools provided for manual operation and help.
- All news signals delivered as structured, machine-readable JSON objects.
